ApplicationCreate.description:
An application typed in. `url` of a collected posting links it; `offer_text` (the offer
pasted) is typeset into the archived offer.pdf.
ApplicationCreate.title: ApplicationCreate

ApplicationOrigin.description: How an application reached the table (blueprint/wp/WP21-applications.md §2).
ApplicationOrigin.title: ApplicationOrigin

ApplicationStatus.description: Where an application stands — the user's, set by hand. Absent means "not tracked".
ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus

LlmCorrectionOut.description: A field the local LLM changed on re-reading the posting, with the quote behind it.
LlmCorrectionOut.title: LlmCorrectionOut

OfferTextRequest.description: Re-archive the offer: from this text, else from the linked posting.
OfferTextRequest.title: OfferTextRequest

Track.description:
A search scored against its own profile, beside the quant feed — blueprint/wp/WP20-tracks.md.

The quant feed is not a track: it is the default, scored into `verdicts` and the
`postings` row itself. A track adds `track_verdicts` rows for the postings in its scope.
Track.title: Track

Triage.description:
The user's verdict on a posting they do not want in the main feed any more.

Absent means "not triaged yet". Both values take the posting out of the feed and
into a list of its own, from which the verdict can be changed or cleared.
Triage.title: Triage

TriageRequest.description: `triage: null` puts the posting back in the main feed.
TriageRequest.title: TriageRequest

archived as a PDF once the response is sent; `null` stops tracking.
